key_insight: BaTiO₃/nickelate superlattices show qualitatively similar interfacial responses in insulating and metallic phases, despite metallic screening charges.
engineering_relevance: The findings inform electrostatic modeling of nickelate/ferroelectric interfaces, rather than directly demonstrating AI or solar-cell performance.
method: First-principles calculations of BaTiO₃/SmNiO₃ and BaTiO₃/BiNiO₃ superlattices.
Comparison of insulating and metallic nickelate phases.
Analysis of interfacial structure, density of states, and charge disproportionation.
evidence_signal: Calculations identify partial screening through altered BiNiO₃ charge disproportionation and little influence of metallic screening charges on the apparent formal-charge polar discontinuity.
watch_item: The formal-charge polar-discontinuity picture has limitations when interpreting and quantifying screening at metallic nickelate/ferroelectric interfaces.
paper_title: The polar discontinuity picture in nickelate superlattices: comparison of the insulating and metallic phases
